app.tagline: Run the bar, roast the beans
app.title: Pour & Roast
bar.batch.d: Two cups of the same drink in one go. Faster, but a pre-order may wait.
bar.dial_in.d: Tune the grind: shots stop tasting bitter.
buy.beans.d: 5 kg of ready-roasted beans. Average quality.
buy.decor.d: A cosier cafe: a little better reviews.
buy.drum.d: Roast more beans in one batch.
buy.heads.d: One more shot at the same time.
buy.ice.d: Makes more ice for iced drinks.
buy.milk_run.d: Extra whole and oat milk, here in a few minutes.
buy.rail.d: More orders can wait before people walk away.
buy.seats.d: More people stop by when they can sit.
buy.service_grinder.d: Resets the wear. A worn grinder can jam.
buy.staff.barista.d: Makes drinks at the espresso machine or the steam wand.
buy.staff.cashier.d: Hands cups over fast and plates the pastries.
buy.staff.roaster.d: Drops your roasts at a good point and blends rested beans each morning.
buy.staff.runner.d: Faster, cheaper milk runs when stock is low.
coach.1: Welcome to the Quayside Cart! Tap Open to start your first day.
coach.10: People like to sit. Buy a table.
coach.11: Rain tomorrow! Rain brings hot drinks and pre-orders. Tap Prep hot drinks.
coach.12: Last one: set the house rule to Deadline first. Pre-orders are never late.
coach.2: A customer ordered. Their ticket is on the rail. Tap the ticket.
coach.3: Now tap the espresso machine. Your barista makes the coffee.
coach.4: The cup is on the pickup shelf. Tap the shelf to hand it over.
coach.5: This order is a latte. Lattes need milk. Tap the milk fridge.
coach.6: Hire a second barista. They will work the steam wand.
coach.7: Two people want the same drink. Turn on Batch to make them together.
coach.8: This is a pre-order with a pickup time. Tap Priority so it is ready on time.
coach.9: The coffee tastes bitter. Press and hold the grinder to dial it in.
coach.done: You're ready! Keep the rail moving and the shots sweet. Settings → How to play shows this again.
contract.bistro.d: A small bistro by the ferry wants your house beans.
contract.ferry.d: The ferry kiosk serves your coffee on every crossing.
crisis.frost.b: One green coffee costs 50 % more for a few days.
crisis.grinder_jam.b: No shots until it's fixed. Hold the grinder to unjam it.
crisis.heat.b: Iced drinks flood the rail. Watch the ice.
crisis.milk_late.b: Today's milk comes 3 hours late. Order a milk run or pause lattes.
crisis.rain.b: Benches empty, pre-orders stack up. Prep hot drinks.
crisis.review_spree.b: Three bad reviews in a row. Fewer people come by until tomorrow.
crisis.wholesale_short.b: Not enough good beans for a wholesale order. A small fee was paid.
forecast.board_help: The forecast board (research) shows three days ahead.
forecast.heat: Iced drinks everywhere. Ice runs out fast.
forecast.prep_hot.d: Pre-brew {n} cups of americano and filter. Served at once. In the urn: {left}.
forecast.prep_ice.d: Add {kg} of ice to the bin.
forecast.rain: Fewer walk-ins, more pre-orders, more hot drinks.
forecast.title: Forecast
graphics.dropped: Graphics lowered to keep the game smooth. You can change it in Settings.
grow.switch_help: Switch branches in the morning plan.
hud.hold_grinder: Hold the grinder to dial it in.
hud.speed_locked: 3× and 4× come with the Speed Pack.
iap.aprons.d: Wine-red aprons for the whole team.
iap.automation.d: The grinder stays dialled in and pre-orders are flagged by themselves.
iap.bundle.d: Edition, Roaster's Pass, Speed, Head Barista+ and every look. Ad-free.
iap.cash_m.d: About two and a half days of income.
iap.comeback.d: Two days of cash to get the cafe going again.
iap.cosmetics_all.d: Every look in the shop, for less.
iap.crisis.d: Fills the fridge with milk and ice right now, plus some cash.
iap.cups.d: Teal takeaway cups on the pickup shelf.
iap.latte_art.d: Gold-sleeved latte-art cups on the pickup shelf.
iap.milestone.d: Four days of cash for your new venue.
iap.noads.d: No more ad breaks between days. Rewards without videos.
iap.offline_plus.d: Earn for up to 10 hours away, at a better rate.
iap.premium.d: Ad-free, a gold espresso machine, a sack of great beans and one extra save slot.
iap.roast_pass.d: Ad-free, a better roaster assistant and 10 % more for wholesale.
iap.slots.d: Three more save slots for more cafes.
iap.speed.d: 3× and 4× speed and an option to skip the day report.
iap.starter.d: Two days of cash and a free extra barista. One time only.
iap.theme_artdeco.d: Deep blue walls with gold trim.
iap.theme_nordic.d: Pale wood and soft white walls.
intro.1.b: A little coffee cart on the rainy Brindle Quay. Your uncle left it to you.
intro.2.b: Every order is a ticket. Choose what's next, who works where, and keep everyone happy.
intro.3.b: Grow into a corner cafe and a roastery. Great beans make great reviews.
menu.help: Fewer drinks = a faster bar. More drinks = bigger tickets.
menu.par_help: Baked each morning up to this number. Leftovers are wasted.
offline.help: Auto top-up and a cashier make the cafe earn more while you're away.
offline.title: While you were away
origin.highland.d: Bright and floral. Shines as a light roast.
origin.lowland.d: Fruity and round. A safe medium roast.
origin.valley.d: Cheap, chocolatey, made for dark roasts.
origin.volcanic.d: Sweet and rare. The best beans on the market.
report.title: Day {n} report
research.forecast_board.d: See the weather three days ahead.
research.head_barista.d: Pre-orders close to pickup are flagged by themselves.
research.origin_trip.d: Unlocks Volcanic Honey on the green market.
research.pastry_oven.d: Better pastries that cost less to bake.
research.pickup_app.d: More pre-orders from the town's app.
research.rail_tablet.d: Two more tickets fit on the rail.
research.roast_assistant.d: You can hire a roaster assistant.
research.roast_profiles.d: Roast light and dark, not only medium.
research.shot_timer.d: Every shot tastes a little better.
review.sold_out: They ran out of what I ordered.
reviews.help: Every customer leaves a review. The average sets your stars, and stars bring people in.
reviews.title: Review wall
reward.auto_dialin.b: Watch a short video: the grinder stays tuned for 90 minutes.
reward.crisis_halve.b: Watch a short video to soften today's problem.
reward.daily_bonus.b: A little cash to start the day.
reward.done_helper: A helper joins the bar for an hour.
reward.done_tune: The grinder stays tuned for a while.
reward.emergency_stock.b: Watch a short video: milk (and ice) topped up now.
reward.extra_barista.b: Watch a short video: a helper works the bar for an hour.
reward.free.b: Included with your ad-free pack — no video.
reward.offline_x2.b: Watch a short video to get it twice.
roast.assist_help: Your assistant will drop it at a good point.
roast.blend.d: Fold {kg} of rested beans into the house beans.
roast.drop_help: Tap Drop in the first-crack sweet spot (70–86 %) for the best beans.
roast.locked.b: The drum roaster opens with the {name}.
roast.rest_help: Fresh roasts rest one day before they taste right.
roast.start_help: Pick green coffee and a roast profile.
rule.deadline.d: The ticket that is due soonest is made first. Pre-orders stay on time.
rule.fifo.d: Tickets are made in the order they arrive.
rule.vip.d: Regulars and special guests are served first.
settings.auto_report.d: Go straight to the next morning (Speed Pack).
settings.privacy_options.d: Change your ad and data choices.
settings.slots_help: Each slot is a separate cafe. More slots come with the Edition or Extra Saves.
settings.title: Settings
shop.cap: Daily pack limit reached. Come back tomorrow.
shop.restore_failed: Could not restore. Try again later.
shop.title: Shop
shop.unavailable: The store is not available right now
stock.auto_beans.d: Buy supplier beans when the hopper runs low.
stock.milk_help: The supplier delivers your order each morning. Half of what's left spoils overnight.
tip.assistant: Hire a roaster assistant in the Bar tab: he drops and blends by himself.
tip.beans_out: Out of beans! Turn on auto top-up or roast more.
tip.blend: Your roast has rested. Open the Roastery tab and tap Blend.
tip.corner: The Corner Cafe is open! Pastries, iced drinks and tables. The cart keeps running as a branch.
tip.forecast: The forecast board shows three days ahead.
tip.frost: Frost at origin: buy a different green coffee for a few days.
tip.head_barista: Your head barista now flags pre-orders that are close to their pickup time.
tip.heat: Heat: iced drinks everywhere. Buy ice or make extra in the forecast.
tip.ice_out: Out of ice! Buy a bag or a bigger ice maker.
tip.jam: A worn grinder jammed. Hold it to unjam, and service it in the Bar tab.
tip.milk_late: The milk van is late. A milk run or fewer milk drinks helps.
tip.milk_out: Out of milk! Order more for tomorrow or send a milk run.
tip.plan: Each morning: check the forecast, the milk order and the menu, then open.
tip.rail_full: The rail was full, so someone walked away. Add a barista or a longer rail.
tip.rain: Rain day: more pre-orders and hot drinks. Prep the urn in the forecast.
tip.report: That was your first day! Stars come from reviews: fast, tasty and on time.
tip.rest: Fresh beans rest until tomorrow. Then blend them into the house beans.
tip.roast: Now roast it: pick a profile and tap Drop in the sweet spot.
tip.roastery: The Roastery Hall is open! Buy green coffee in the Roastery tab.
tip.sold_out: A pastry sold out. Bake more in the Menu tab.
tip.spree: Bad reviews hurt footfall. Check the dial-in and the wait times.
tip.walked: A customer gave up waiting. Hire, add a group head, or set a house rule.
tip.wholesale: Wholesale needs enough beans of good quality on the delivery day.
toast.dialed: Grinder dialled in. Shots taste sweet again.
toast.drop: Batch dropped. It rests until tomorrow.
toast.drop_sweet: Right in the sweet spot! A great batch.
toast.fridge: Milk in the fridge: whole {whole}, oat {oat}.
toast.handover: {n} orders handed over. Smiles all round!
upgrade.title: Upgrades
venue.cart.d: A coffee cart under a striped awning on the quay.
venue.corner.d: Seats, a pastry case, iced drinks and more customers.
venue.roastery.d: A big hall with a drum roaster. Roast your own beans and sell wholesale.
